title: Models for the architecture of the human inner kinetochore CCAN complex on centromeric α-satellite CENP-A nucleosome arrays
authors: Yu C; Muir KW; Yang J; Zhang Z; McLaughlin SH; Barford D
one_liner_zh: 该文通过冷冻电镜解析CCAN复合物与CENP-A核小体及α-卫星DNA阵列的结构，研究蛋白质-DNA互作架构，但对象为着丝粒蛋白而非典型TF-DNA体系，且方法为结构生物学而非AI或物理模拟，故评分为5。
abstract: Human kinetochores assemble onto centromeric DNA defined by tandem copies of thousands of the 171 bp α-satellite repeat sequence. The centromere-specific CENP-A nucleosome (CENP-A Nuc ) recruits the inner kinetochore constitutive centromere associated network (CCAN) complex. A previous cryo-EM structure of CCAN bound to a CENP-A Nuc reconstituted with a 171 bp α-satellite repeat sequence showed how extranucleosomal linker DNA threads through an internal tunnel in the CCAN complex. To understand the higher-order architecture of the inner kinetochore assembled onto α-satellite repeat arrays, we have determined cryo-EM structures of CCAN with longer DNA sequences. These include free DNA and single and dimeric α-satellite repeats with CENP-A nucleosomes. We show from the structures of CCAN bound to both free DNA and monomeric CENP-A Nuc that CCAN engages 65-70 bp of DNA comprising 30-35 bp of an upstream α-satellite repeat. This upstream DNA interacts with the histone-fold domain subunits of the CENP-TWSX module in a manner resembling how DNA is wrapped in nucleosomes. A complex of CCAN assembled onto a dimeric α-satellite repeat with two CENP-A nucleosomes showed that CCAN can only be accommodated on the linker DNA by unwrapping DNA from the CENP-TWSX module together with 25 bp of DNA from the upstream nucleosome. We discuss the implications of these results for models of CCAN assembly on arrays of α-satellite chromatin containing CENP-A Nuc .
abstract_zh: 人类着丝粒组装在由数千个171 bp α-卫星重复序列串联拷贝定义的着丝粒DNA上。着丝粒特异性CENP-A核小体（CENP-A Nuc）招募内层着丝粒组成型着丝粒相关网络（CCAN）复合物。先前一项CCAN结合到由171 bp α-卫星重复序列重构的CENP-A Nuc上的冷冻电镜结构显示，核小体外连接DNA如何穿过CCAN复合物内部通道。为了理解组装在α-卫星重复阵列上的内层着丝粒的高阶结构，我们确定了CCAN与更长DNA序列的冷冻电镜结构。这些包括游离DNA以及带有CENP-A核小体的单体和二聚体α-卫星重复序列。我们从CCAN结合到游离DNA和单体CENP-A Nuc的结构中显示，CCAN结合65-70 bp的DNA，其中包括上游α-卫星重复序列的30-35 bp。该上游DNA与CENP-TWSX模块的组蛋白折叠域亚基相互作用，其方式类似于DNA在核小体中的缠绕。一个CCAN组装到带有两个CENP-A核小体的二聚体α-卫星重复序列上的复合物显示，CCAN只能通过从CENP-TWSX模块解绕DNA以及从上游核小体解绕25 bp DNA来适应连接DNA。我们讨论了这些结果对CCAN在含有CENP-A Nuc的α-卫星染色质阵列上组装模型的意义。
